audio_description:
Past a tall rusted windmill-tower, Balamb Garden rests at Fishermans Horizon.
A local sits fishing under a striped umbrella on the weathered catwalks.
The Garden's wake and spray churn behind him.

context.scene_title: Balamb Garden arrives at Fishermans Horizon — the drifting mobile Garden reaches the seaside scrap-town (Disc 2).

context.summary: Past a tall rusted windmill-tower, the huge bulk of Balamb Garden has come to rest at Fishermans Horizon. A local sits fishing under a striped umbrella on the weathered catwalks as the Garden's wake and spray churn behind him, establishing the ramshackle ocean town where the Garden lodges.
